deltas.note_on_discrepancy: The two deltas differ (45979 vs 31651) because MAX(id) tracks the SOURCE high-water (all rows ever assigned an id, including any subsequently routed to COLD or filtered), while HOT row COUNT(*) tracks only rows currently resident in the HOT table. This gap is expected and matches the same accounting pattern seen at cutover (source high-water 6835535 vs combined HOT+COLD rows 5393999). No COLD growth has occurred since cutover (Part 8), so the full id-vs-count gap here is attributable to non-transfer_index id consumers or in-flight/filtered rows, not silent data loss -- flagged for informational tracking, not a health failure.
